description: Type text as real per-character keystrokes (fires keydown/keypress/input/keyup per char), unlike electron_type which sets the value directly. Focuses ref/selector first when given; otherwise types into the active element. For a code editor (Monaco / EditContext), the reliable path is electron_type_into_editor (it clicks the editor content area, e.g. '.monaco-editor .view-lines', then types into the focused editor) — do NOT target the hidden textarea, which modern editors ignore. force:true focuses an offscreen/aria-hidden input but a swallowed keystroke returns TYPE_NO_EFFECT. Options: force, timeoutMs, waitForFocusMs, requireEditable. Returns: { ok, session_id, typed, focused: { role, name, editable } | null } (where the keys went). Errors: SELECTOR_NO_MATCH / REF_NOT_FOUND (carries similar_refs), ELEMENT_NOT_VISIBLE (retryable), TYPE_NO_EFFECT (typing changed nothing — use electron_type_into_editor), NO_FOCUSED_EDITABLE, NOT_RUNNING, BAD_ARGUMENT.

ref.description: Element ref from a snapshot (resolves to [data-sw-ref="N"]). Provide ref OR selector.

requireEditable.description: Fail with NO_FOCUSED_EDITABLE unless keys go to an editable element.

selector.description: CSS selector. Provide ref OR selector, not both.

sessionId.description: Target session id. Omit when a single session is running.

text.description: The text to type, character by character.

timeoutMs.description: Actionability budget in ms (default 5000, clamped to 30000).

waitForFocusMs.description: No target: wait up to this many ms for an editable element to take focus.

name: electron_keyboard_type
title: Type text as real keystrokes
